description.value: Hy's Steakhouse & Cocktail Bar is one of Canada's oldest and most storied steakhouse brands, founded in Calgary in 1955 and now anchoring a prime block of Hornby Street in downtown Vancouver. The two-storey restaurant is known for its dark mahogany interiors, tableside service theatre, and Canada Prime Grade beef. It sits in the heart of the downtown core, making it a recognizable landmark for cyclists navigating the Hornby Street bike corridor.
